protocol.description:
The wallpaper protocol allows clients to set and observe the wallpapers displayed by a wallpaper daemon.
Outputs are identified by the names the compositor advertises for them, e.g. through wl_output.name (DP-1, HDMI-A-1, ...). Output names are opaque and case-sensitive.
Daemons expose this protocol non-exclusively, with core.settings.basic.wallpaper in its protocol-level required_permissions. Clients must request that permission before connecting.
Daemons must expose a GLOBAL:WAYLAND_DISPLAY property set to the Wayland display they render on. Clients should query for this protocol filtered by their own WAYLAND_DISPLAY, so that nested or concurrent sessions each reach their own daemon.

object.name: hp_wallpaper_manager_v1
object.description: This object is a core manager object bound upon creation.

c2s.name: get_wallpaper_object
c2s.description: Creates a wallpaper object, used to set a wallpaper. See hp_wallpaper_v1.

c2s.name: get_status_object
c2s.description: Creates a status object, used to observe the displayed wallpapers. See hp_wallpaper_status_v1.

s2c.name: output_added
s2c.description: Sent for each existing output immediately after binding, and then for every output added afterwards.

s2c.name: output_removed
s2c.description: Sent when an output previously announced by output_added is removed.

c2s.name: destroy
c2s.description: Destroys this object. Objects created from it remain valid until destroyed.

value.name: stretch
value.description: scaled to the output's size, ignoring the aspect ratio

value.name: cover
value.description: scaled to cover the whole output, cropping any excess

value.name: contain
value.description: scaled to fit entirely within the output

value.name: tile
value.description: repeated across the output at its native size

value.name: inert_wallpaper_object
value.description: attempted to use an inert wallpaper object

object.name: hp_wallpaper_v1
object.description:
This object describes a wallpaper to apply. Set its state with path, fit_mode and output_name, then send apply.
After apply, this object is inert. Any request other than destroy raises an inert_wallpaper_object protocol error.

c2s.name: path
c2s.description:
Set the image file path for the wallpaper. This is required.
The path must be absolute. It is resolved in the daemon's filesystem, not the client's: paths inside a client's sandbox may not exist for the daemon.

c2s.name: fit_mode
c2s.description:
Set how the image is fit to the output. Defaults to cover.
A value outside of wallpaper_fit_mode raises an invalid_fit_mode protocol error.

c2s.name: output_name
c2s.description:
Set the output for the wallpaper. Setting this to empty (or not setting it at all) makes it a wildcard fallback, displayed on every output without a wallpaper of its own.
See hp_wallpaper_manager_v1.output_added and hp_wallpaper_manager_v1.output_removed for tracking output names.

arg.name: output_name
arg.summary: output name, or empty for all outputs

c2s.name: apply
c2s.description:
Applies this wallpaper, replacing the previous one set for the same output, or the previous wildcard fallback. Exactly one success or failed event follows, unless the client disconnects first.
Fails with invalid_path if the path was not set, is not absolute, or does not refer to a file the daemon can read. Fails with invalid_output if output_name does not name a present output.
Whether applied wallpapers persist across daemon restarts is implementation-defined.

s2c.name: failed
s2c.description: The wallpaper was not applied, and the daemon's state is unchanged. See the error for more information.

object.name: hp_wallpaper_status_v1
object.description: This object reports the wallpapers displayed on each output.

s2c.name: active_wallpaper
s2c.description:
Reports the path of the wallpaper displayed on an output. This is sent for each existing output immediately after creation, and then every time the path displayed on an output changes, including for newly added outputs.
An empty path means the output displays no wallpaper. The output name is never empty: a wildcard fallback is reported for each output displaying it.
No event is sent when an output is removed. See hp_wallpaper_manager_v1.output_removed.

arg.name: path
arg.summary: wallpaper path, or empty for none
